qualifies.inputs_available: Archived compound set present in this checkout (1128 data rows) with SHA-256 matching SOURCES.md, verified above; public retrieval URL recorded in SOURCES.md.
qualifies.method_no_paywall: Running the reproduction needs no paywalled access: the published equation, open RDKit descriptors, and the public compound set (DeepChem mirror, URL in SOURCES.md). The ACS paper text itself is paywalled; the run-time extraction step reads it, but no licence blocks the computation.
qualifies.result_checkable: The paper publishes the model and its own reported fit statistics; the gate re-scores predicted against measured across the full archived set and files every compound where the model misses badly, then hands the archived inputs to the independent verifier for re-execution within a pre-stated tolerance (SLICE1 section 4; gate/GATE_PREP.md).

question: Can the published Delaney (2004) ESOL aqueous-solubility model be reproduced from the archived compound set?
